svg.title: Lagune in an AI chat
svg.desc: In a "Project charter" session, the user runs /lagune-charter It's a SaaS where each company manages its own users and the agent answers "I found that the project uses:" Rust, Database, Multi-tenant, User sign-up. In a "User sign-up" session, the user runs /lagune Implement user sign-up and the agent answers "Matched specializations:" credential-endpoint, access-control, crypto, sql, regex, rust. In a "Blue Team Audit" session, the user runs /lagune-detect and the agent answers "Scanned the whole project and mapped 4 findings:" Invoice export, Database password, Password reset, Search.

g.text: /lagune-charter It's a SaaS where each company manages its own users
I found that the project uses:
All set! You’re ready to build.
Rate limits and anti-automation on sign-up
Tenant isolation and Argon2id password storage
Sound unsafe code and checked integer math
Scanned the whole project and mapped 4 findings:
One company can read another company’s invoices
Written straight into the source code
User input can rewrite the SQL query
Next, /lagune-plan turns them into prioritized fixes.
/lagune-charter It's a SaaS where each company manages its own users
